text: Short mein humne dekha ki ₹100 ki dawai pe chemist ko lagbhag ₹20 milte hain.
Lekin maine aapse do secrets ka waada kiya tha.
Aaj hum poora hisaab nikaalenge… medical shop kholne mein kitna kharcha aata hai, mahine ki kamaai kitni hoti hai, kharche kitne hote hain… aur asli paisa kahan se aata hai.
Chaliye shuru karte hain.
Sabse pehle samjho ki dawai aati kahan se hai.
Company dawai banati hai, phir woh jaati hai C&F agent aur stockist ke paas, wahan se distributor, aur distributor se aapke mohalle ka chemist.
Har step pe sab apna margin rakhte hain.
Distributor ka margin lagbhag 8 se 10 percent hota hai, aur chemist ka branded dawaiyon pe lagbhag 16 se 20 percent.
Aur haan, MRP mein GST bhi shaamil hota hai.
Abhi ke niyamon mein zyaadatar dawaiyon pe 5 percent GST lagta hai, aur kuch zaroori dawaiyon pe toh zero.
Ab sabse bada sawaal… medical shop kholne mein kitna paisa lagta hai?
Ek chhote ya medium shehar ka udaharan lete hain.
Dawaiyon ka stock, lagbhag ₹5 se 8 lakh.
Yeh sabse bada kharcha hai, kyunki hazaaron tarah ki dawaiyan rakhni padti hain.
Dukaan ka interior, yaani rack, counter aur lighting, milaakar ₹2 se 3 lakh.
Fridge, computer aur billing software, lagbhag ₹50 hazaar se 1 lakh.
Fridge zaroori hai, kyunki insulin aur kuch injection thande mein rakhne padte hain.
Aur dukaan ka deposit aur advance kiraya, location ke hisaab se ₹50 hazaar se 2 lakh.
Matlab kul milaakar lagbhag ₹8 se 15 lakh.
Bade shehar ya main market mein yeh aur zyaada ho sakta hai.
Medical shop aise hi nahi khol sakte.
Iske liye Drug License chahiye, jo rajya ke Drug Control Department se milta hai.
Retail ke liye Form 20 aur Form 21 ka license hota hai.
Sabse zaroori niyam… dukaan pe ek registered pharmacist hona chahiye, yaani jiske paas D.Pharm ya B.Pharm ki degree ho.
Agar aap khud pharmacist nahi ho, toh aapko ek pharmacist ko naukri pe rakhna padega.
Iske alawa dukaan kam se kam 10 square meter ki honi chahiye, fridge hona chahiye, aur GST registration aur shop registration bhi chahiye.
License ki sarkari fees kuch hazaar rupaye hoti hai, aur process mein aam taur pe 1 se 2 mahine lag jaate hain.
Ab aate hain kamaai pe.
Maan lo ek achhi location ki dukaan roz ₹20,000 ki dawai bechti hai.
Toh mahine ki sale hui lagbhag ₹6 lakh.
Ab branded aur generic dawaiyon ko milaakar average margin maan lo 20 percent.
Toh mahine ka gross profit hua lagbhag ₹1 lakh 20 hazaar.
Sunne mein achha lag raha hai na?
Lekin ruko… abhi kharche baaki hain.
Dukaan ka kiraya, ₹20 se 30 hazaar.
Pharmacist aur helper ki salary, ₹25 se 30 hazaar.
Bijli ka bill, kyunki fridge aur lights chalti rehti hain, ₹4 se 5 hazaar.
Software, internet aur chhote-mote kharche, ₹3 se 5 hazaar.
Aur expiry aur tooti-phooti dawaiyon ka loss, ₹5 se 6 hazaar.
Aur ek bahut bada chhupa hua kharcha hai… discount.
Aajkal online pharmacy waale 15 se 20 percent discount dete hain.
Grahak ko rokne ke liye local chemist ko bhi 5 se 10 percent discount dena padta hai, aur woh seedha margin se katta hai.
Sab ghataane ke baad, ek normal dukaan ka net profit bachta hai lagbhag ₹40 se 60 hazaar mahina.
Ab woh secret, jiska waada kiya tha… generic dawaiyan.
Branded dawai pe margin 20 percent ke aaspaas hota hai, lekin kai generic dawaiyon pe chemist ka margin 50 percent ya usse bhi zyaada ho sakta hai.
Isiliye kai chemist generic dawaiyan zyaada rakhte hain.
Aur sarkar ki Jan Aushadhi yojana bhi hai, jismein sasti generic dawaiyan milti hain.
Wahan chemist ko margin ke saath-saath kuch incentive bhi milta hai.

Doosra secret hai woh counter, jo dawai ke bagal mein hota hai… cosmetics, protein powder, baby products, sanitary items, sugar-free products, aur surgical saamaan, jaise BP machine, sugar test kit aur bandage.
In pe margin aksar 20 se 40 percent hota hai, aur inke daam pe sarkar ka control bhi nahi hota.
Kai smart chemist lab test ke liye sample collection, home delivery, aur regular grahakon ki mahine ki dawai ka fixed order bhi rakhte hain.
Yahi chhoti-chhoti cheezein milkar ek normal dukaan ko ek bahut kamaane waali dukaan bana deti hain.
Lekin yeh business aasaan bhi nahi hai.
Online pharmacy ka competition hai, dawaiyan expire hoti hain, grahak udhaar maangte hain, aur niyamon ka paalan sakhti se karna padta hai.
Bina prescription ke kuch dawaiyan bechna galat bhi hai aur gair-kaanooni bhi.
Isliye location, imaandari aur grahak ka bharosa… yahi is business ki asli poonji hai.
Toh yeh tha medical shop business ka poora hisaab-kitaab.
Agar aap medical shop kholna chahte ho, toh comment mein zaroor batao.
Dhyaan rahe, is video mein bataaye gaye saare numbers ek andaaza hain.
Asli kharcha aur kamaai aapke shehar, location, dukaan ke size aur sarkari niyamon ke hisaab se alag ho sakti hai.
Business shuru karne se pehle kisi anubhavi chemist ya expert se salaah zaroor lein.
Yeh video sirf jaankari ke liye hai.
Aisi hi business ki aur videos ke liye channel ko subscribe karo.
Agli video mein milte hain!
